value.rationale: The result supplies two distinct sharp natural survival cutoffs for planning movement in anti-phased habitats, showing why small corridor tests can have the opposite sign from globally optimal full movement. It also gives a rigorously constructed survival-rescue instance and a no-interior-maximum classification, independently useful as a model benchmark. It is not a generic convexity exercise because its biological hypotheses and precise global-versus-local implication are essential.
